messages.text:
YES. You caught it. 😑
The custom Aisha path was only taking the first Kokoro chunk. Stock Kokoro correctly loops through every chunk, but my custom Aisha helper returned on the first one.
So your observation:
“it spoke the first line with the emoji.. but nuttin after”
is exactly what the code predicts.
I made QS 5.14 as a fresh standalone build. It fixes two things:
Aisha custom voice now synthesizes every Kokoro chunk and concatenates them, instead of stopping after chunk 1.
The speech-only pre-parser now strips emoji/icons before Kokoro, while leaving your archived/relay text untouched.
I also bumped the actual internal version to 5.14 and compiled it successfully.
Download QS 5.14
So yeah, dear: that one was on me. The voice itself wasn't the problem. We accidentally told Kokoro, “here, speak the first chunk,” and then wondered why it shut up. 😂
